name: Overlay
description: Full-viewport translucent backdrop used behind Dialog and Sheet to focus attention on the foreground surface.

whenToUse: Always pair behind `Dialog` and `Sheet` to dim background content and clearly separate the modal layer.
whenNotToUse: Do not render behind non-modal floating surfaces such as `Calendar`, `Tooltip`, or `DropdownMenu`.

behaviorRules: Bind fill strictly to `Surfaces/Overlay` token, blocking pointer interaction with background elements while active.
